decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Design and Access Statement, Photos of existing front bay windows received 08/12/10. Drawing Number- Unnumbered new window drawing received 04/03/11 ) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Details of joinery shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the double glazing have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: The replacement of two bay windows to match the original windows.
